import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
paths={name:root/'artifacts/baselines'/directory/'war-relay' for name,directory in [
    ('before','control-frame-final-candidate'),('observed','queue-observation'),('selected','queue-retirement-candidate')]}
client=root/'artifacts/baselines/queue-wave-clients/queue_waves'
output=root/'docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-queue-recovery-comparison.json'
record={'scope':'Fifteen sequential fresh-process three-wave recovery cases. Five repetitions rotate original/instrumented-retention/selected order.32 persistent receivers,8MiB changing values followed by48 changing scalars per wave. Complete frame/FIFO, publication marker, departure, Close/EOF, byte/counter/resource checks. Same frozen client, server CPUs0-3/client4-7. No allocator replacement, builds, profiling or competing load tests. Server CPU covers ready-to-idle, including gate management and progress during pauses; publish/drain client intervals exclude gate pauses. RSS is event-boundary sampling.',
    'variants':{role:{'path':str(path.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(path)} for role,path in paths.items()},
    'client':{'path':str(client.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(client),'source_path':'artifacts/baselines/queue-wave-clients/queue_waves.rs','source_sha256':sha(client.parent/'queue_waves.rs')},
    'runner_sha256':sha(root/'scripts/queue-waves.py'),'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'driver_sha256':sha(__file__),
    'cases':[],'passed':False}
roles=list(paths)
for repetition in range(1,6):
    start=(repetition-1)%3
    for role in roles[start:]+roles[:start]:
        trace=output.with_name(f'{output.stem}-{role}-{repetition}.json')
        command=[sys.executable,str(root/'scripts/queue-waves.py'),'--server',str(paths[role]),'--client',str(client),'--output',str(trace)]
        run=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
        data=json.loads(trace.read_text());assert run.returncode==0 and data['passed'],run.stdout+run.stderr
        assert not data['profile_diagnostic'] and data['server_sha256']==record['variants'][role]['sha256']
        assert data['client_sha256']==record['client']['sha256'] and data['client_source_sha256']==record['client']['source_sha256']
        ready=next(e for e in data['events'] if e['event']=='ready');idle=next(e for e in data['events'] if e['event']=='idle')
        row={'kind':role,'repetition':repetition,'trace':str(trace.relative_to(root)),'trace_sha256':sha(trace),'passed':True,
             'publish_ms':statistics.median(e['published_ms'] for e in data['events'] if e['event']=='drained'),
             'drain_ms':statistics.median(e['drain_ms'] for e in data['events'] if e['event']=='drained'),
             'server_ready_to_idle_cpu_seconds':idle['process']['cpu_seconds']-ready['process']['cpu_seconds'],
             'idle_rss_mib':idle['process']['VmRSS']/1024,
             'idle_queue_capacity_bytes':idle['metrics'].get('war_output_queue_capacity_bytes'),
             'peak_queue_capacity_bytes':idle['metrics'].get('war_output_queue_peak_capacity_bytes')}
        record['cases'].append(row);output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
record['medians']={}
for role in roles:
    rows=[r for r in record['cases'] if r['kind']==role]
    summary={key:statistics.median(r[key] for r in rows) for key in ['publish_ms','drain_ms','server_ready_to_idle_cpu_seconds','idle_rss_mib']}
    summary['ranges']={key:[min(r[key] for r in rows),max(r[key] for r in rows)] for key in ['publish_ms','drain_ms','server_ready_to_idle_cpu_seconds']}
    record['medians'][role]=summary
record['passed']=True;output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(record['medians']),flush=True)
